title: Name reusable steps
summary: Perl: Name reusable steps. Call twice(7).
introduction: A subroutine is a named set of steps. @_ holds its inputs. Read the example, then check the result.

blocks.text: Install Perl 5. Save one example as lesson.pl and run perl lesson.pl.

blocks.title: Name reusable steps

blocks.text: The input assignment reads the first value in @_. return sends back twice that value.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Copy the input from @_ before using it.
